choice_groups.name: Physical skills

source.section: Physical/Athletic Program; scholastic Hand to Hand selection costs; Physical skill introduction

choice_groups.guidance: Select four choices: Expert costs two, Martial Arts and Assassin three, other reviewed Physical skills one. Only the currently reviewed Physical catalog is available; other Physical skills remain pending. Attribute, resource and combat effects receive no percentage education bonus.

skills.name: Computer Repair
notes: The source requires separate procedure and actual repair/sabotage rolls; a failed repair does not work and may be tried again. Computer Operation and Programming are not required.

skills.name: Computer Programming
notes: This context applies only without Computer Hacking. That separate Rogue skill and its cross-skill condition remain unsupported; normal programming proficiency is unchanged.

skills.name: Cryptography

additional_checks.name: After only ten minutes of study

notes: Normally requires two hours of study; a failed attempt requires another two hours before retrying. The displayed short-study check applies after only ten minutes.

skills.name: Surveillance Systems
notes: Computer Operation and Literacy are additionally required for complex, high-tech systems. This definition includes tailing and stake-outs; a failed tailing check alerts the subject. Equipment failure impairs surveillance; failed concealment leaves a bug easily discovered.

skills.name: Read Sensory Equipment

source.section: Communications cross-reference to Pilot Related Skills

notes: Available under Communications through the explicit Pilot Related cross-reference. This proficiency covers operating and interpreting conventional sensory devices.

skills.name: First Aid

source.section: Medical â€” First Aid and Holistic Medicine

notes: Rudimentary treatment includes bandaging, stopping bleeding, CPR and common antiseptics or painkillers.

skills.name: Holistic Medicine

source.section: Medical â€” First Aid and Holistic Medicine

notes: Successful treatment with suitable natural remedies can help wounds heal twice as quickly as normal.
Failed treatment or concoction rolls do not work. Suitable plants may be seasonal or found only in remote regions.

skills.name: Pick Pockets

source.section: Rogue Skills: Pick Pockets, Palming and Seduction

guidance: Failure leaves the item in place and has a 67% chance that the intended victim recognizes the attempt. The seduced-target check applies only when this character has successfully seduced that victim.

skills.name: Seduction

source.section: Rogue Skills: Pick Pockets, Palming and Seduction

guidance: Successfully seduced victims perform skills at half proficiency and take twice as long; they have no initiative, and initiative bonuses halve when attacked by someone other than the seducer.

The seducer acts first against that victim; any roll above 4 succeeds. The victim cannot defend against the first attack and loses one action from surprise or horror. These target combat effects remain source guidance until Heroes combat support is complete.
+5% Pick Pockets, Palming/planting, Cardsharp, Sing and Dance against a successfully seduced victim; available Pick Pockets, Palming and Cardsharp contexts are projected here.
One additional target may be influenced per three experience levels; Heroes advancement remains pending.
Normal mortal M.A./P.B. bonuses stop at 30 even when a manual attribute value exceeds that limit; god/alien exceptions remain pending.

skills.name: Palming
guidance: Conceal a small object in the hand so it seems to disappear. When acquired, adds 5% to Pick Pockets.
A successfully seduced victim gives a conditional +5% Palming check when Seduction is acquired. This is not a general bonus against other targets.

skills.name: Cardsharp
guidance: Card handling, marked cards, counting and odds. A failed check fumbles the trick, misreads markings or exposes cheating.
Acquired Palming adds 4%. Acquired Seduction permits a conditional 5% against a successfully seduced target.

skills.name: Concealment
guidance: Objects must be no more than 14 inches long/high, 6 inches wide and 10 pounds.
Small/light items and handguns or knives hidden under clothes each have a stated 5% context. These alternative contexts are displayed separately; no combined 10% is assumed.
Concealment receives Extraordinary M.A. as reviewed sleight-of-hand under the selected interpretation.

skills.name: Pick Locks
guidance: Mechanical locks only; sophisticated computer/electronic locks are excluded. Each attempt takes 1D6 melee rounds; a failed attempt leaves the lock holding and may be retried.

skills.name: Prowl
guidance: Successful stealth avoids being seen or heard and permits a sneak attack. This creator displays proficiency; it does not resolve an attack. Acrobatics/Gymnastics included Prowl and their training bonuses remain separate unfinished work.

skills.name: Streetwise
guidance: Recognize gangs, dangerous locations, criminal contacts, dealers, drugs and undercover agents by a skill check.

skills.name: Ventriloquism
guidance: Throw the voice up to 10 feet (3 m). A poorly thrown voice or visible mouth movement makes the trick fail.
Extraordinary M.A. applies under the reviewed deception classification: the skill explicitly disguises the origin of a voice. This is an interpretation, not a separately stated Ventriloquism bonus.

skills.name: Art
guidance: Secondary Art is talented amateur work; professional quality requires scholastic training.

skills.name: General Repair/Maintenance
guidance: Roll separately to diagnose the problem and to make the repair. After failure, at most two retries are allowed.
Minor armor patchwork restores 2D6 S.D.C. under the source rule; equipment repair is not yet automated and does not change character starting S.D.C.
Difficult items are extremely damaged, complex, high-tech or alien. That context halves normal capped proficiency exactly; fractional percentages are retained without invented rounding.

skills.name: Photography
guidance: Still photography, lighting, camera equipment and film storage, development, enlargement and duplication.

skills.name: Body Building & Weight Lifting

source.section: Physical Skills: Body Building & Weight Lifting

guidance: Physical effects apply once per acquired skill. Recorded dice are retained on removal and reselection. Attribute house rules and exceptional bonus dice do not apply to these bonuses.

skills.name: Running
guidance: Physical effects apply once per acquired skill. Recorded dice are retained on removal and reselection. Attribute house rules and exceptional bonus dice do not apply to these bonuses.

skills.name: Hand to Hand: Basic

notes: Critical strike on natural 19 or 20; double damage.
Critical strike or knockout from behind.

source.section: Physical skill cost / Hand to Hand: Basic

guidance: Hand to Hand: Basic costs one Secondary selection. Its level-1 combat effects apply once; duplicate entries do not grant additional training.
Its two additional attacks replace the untrained level-1 contribution. Trained parries are automatic; a dodge consumes one action.
Heroes advancement remains unfinished; later training bonuses and maneuvers are not yet active.

skills.name: Hand to Hand: Expert

notes: Karate kick 2D4 and two other kicks of choice.
Triple-damage critical strike or knockout from behind.

source.section: Hand to Hand: Expert training and selection cost

guidance: Hand to Hand: Expert costs 2 Secondary selections. Only the active training profile contributes combat effects.
Trained parries are automatic; a dodge consumes one action. Additional attacks replace the untrained contribution.
Later bonuses and maneuvers await Heroes advancement; current characters support level 1 only.

skills.name: Hand to Hand: Martial Arts

notes: Karate kick 2D4 and four other kicks of choice except jump kicks.

source.section: Hand to Hand: Martial Arts training and selection cost

guidance: Hand to Hand: Martial Arts costs 3 Secondary selections. Only the active training profile contributes combat effects.
Trained parries are automatic; a dodge consumes one action. Additional attacks replace the untrained contribution.
Later bonuses and maneuvers await Heroes advancement; current characters support level 1 only.

skills.name: Hand to Hand: Assassin

notes: Karate kick 2D4 and two other kicks of choice except jump kicks.

source.section: Hand to Hand: Assassin training and selection cost

guidance: Hand to Hand: Assassin costs 3 Secondary selections. Only the active training profile contributes combat effects.
Trained parries are automatic; a dodge consumes one action. Additional attacks replace the untrained contribution.
Later bonuses and maneuvers await Heroes advancement; current characters support level 1 only.
Secondary Assassin training requires evil alignment; alignment is adjudicated on the honor system.

skills.name: Climbing
guidance: Check Climbing once per 20 feet (6 meters) of vertical ascent. After failure, roll once more to regain grip; two successive failures mean falling.
Rappelling is a separate proficiency for rope-assisted ascending and descending climbs, including walls, cliffs and helicopter descents.
Neither check grants attribute, S.D.C. or combat bonuses. Secondary selections have no scholastic bonus.

skills.name: Swimming
guidance: Routine surface pace is three times effective P.S. in yards/meters per 15-second melee; ordinary duration in minutes equals effective P.E.

Surface swimming, fast swimming and underwater combat count as strenuous activity. Routine underwater activity with S.C.U.B.A. or similar equipment is light activity. S.C.U.B.A. is a separate skill and is not granted.
Selected fatigue-rate powers modify endurance time independently of Swimming proficiency and pace. Ordinary duration and the power source remain shown separately.
Swimming grants no attribute, S.D.C. or combat bonus.

skills.name: Athletics (general)
guidance: Athletics grants P.S.+1, Speed+1D6, S.D.C.+2D4, parry+1, dodge+1 and roll with impact+1. Effects apply once per acquired skill; recorded dice survive removal and reselection.
Athletics combines with other Physical skills and the selected Hand to Hand profile. It does not grant a training profile or change the action cost of parrying.
Attribute house-rule options and exceptional bonus dice do not apply to Athletics dice.

skills.name: S.C.U.B.A. (Advanced Swimming)
guidance: S.C.U.B.A. requires Swimming. It is a separate skill and does not grant Swimming or any underwater equipment. Missing prerequisites remain on the honor system.

Routine equipment-assisted underwater pace is twice effective P.S. in yards/meters per 15-second melee; ordinary duration equals effective P.E. minutes. Routine activity is light; fast swimming and combat are strenuous.

The stated maximum safe depth without the bends is about 120 feet (36.5 meters). Deeper dives need appropriate depressurization, special suits or submarines; decompression and equipment selection are not simulated here.
Selected fatigue-rate powers change endurance time, not pace or proficiency. S.C.U.B.A. grants no attribute, S.D.C. or combat bonus.

skills.name: Boxing
guidance: Boxing adds one attack per melee, parry+2, dodge+2, P.S.+2, roll with impact+1 and S.D.C.+3D6. Effects apply once; recorded S.D.C. dice survive removal and reselection.
When fighting with fists, a natural 20 automatically knocks out an ordinary opponent for 1D6 melees. No knockout announcement is required. This does not apply to every weapon attack.

Bionic characters, alter-physical-structure heroes, mineral aliens and characters with superhuman strength or tough bodies are stunned instead: -4 to strike, parry and dodge. No separate stun duration is stated here.
Boxing combines with the active Hand to Hand profile and other Physical skills. It does not grant a training profile or change the action cost of an untrained parry.
Attribute generation options and exceptional bonus dice do not apply to Boxing S.D.C. dice. Knockout duration is an encounter roll, not a character-generation roll.

Shared grants occur once with the highest eligible program bonus. Universal Basic Mathematics receives its scholastic bonus once when selected in a supported program; this duplicate-grant reconciliation is an explicit implementation interpretation. Secondary selections never add an education bonus.

Business, Medical Assistant, Computer and Communications fixed grants/explicit alternatives plus Physical/Athletic weighted choices, supported Secondary selections and two universal percentages are automated. Other programs, remaining skill catalogs, repeated-program category choices, Street literacy trades and advancement remain unfinished.

Universal Speak Native Language (+25%) and Read/Write Native Language (+20%) remain source guidance. Native speaking base is unspecified; educated native literacy is 98%, and Street Schooled literacy is 30% +2% per level unless trading a skill. Their arithmetic interaction remains pending.
Education bonuses apply once to scholastic skills; I.Q. bonuses apply once to all supported skills. Ordinary proficiency is capped at 98%.

High School does not permit Business, Medical Assistant or Communications (original printed 45 / PDF 46, restriction item 1). Honor-system choices stay saved without an ineligible scholastic bonus. Earlier exact pins require an explicit reviewed update.

Paramedic treatment procedures remain source guidance: serious injury/coma uses two successes out of three checks; a failed attempt can be retried by another character or after six minutes concentrating. This creator displays proficiency, not an in-session treatment simulator.

Physical/Athletic selects four weighted choices from the reviewed Physical catalog. Repeated-program remaining-category entitlements, other Physical skills and Physical Training power-category rules remain unfinished.

source.section: Secondary Skills and Secondary Skill List

guidance: Secondary skills receive no education bonus. I.Q. applies once. Reviewed selected-power bonuses apply separately; other power-category bonuses remain pending.

Technical: any; Pilot Basic: any; Science: Astronomy/Mathematics only; Electrical: Basic Electronics only; Communications: Radio Basic or TV/Video only. Biology, Paramedic, Computer Repair, Radio Scramblers and Radio Satellite are outside these eligible categories. Only currently defined skills are covered. Medical: First Aid or Holistic Medicine; Holistic Medicine uses two selections.
Secondary proficiency does not imply professional or commercial quality. A shared program grant retains its program quality; a skill solely selected as Secondary is competent, non-professional.
Other Secondary categories and special selection costs, including other hand-to-hand training, remain unfinished. Street skill choices and literacy trades remain separate pending work.
Rogue Secondary: any except Computer Hacking, Find Contraband and Safecracking. Reviewed available Rogue skills each cost one selection.

Physical Secondaries: any except Acrobatics, Gymnastics, Boxing and Wrestling. Reviewed Body Building, Running and Hand to Hand: Basic each cost one selection; other training definitions remain unfinished.
Expert costs two choices; Martial Arts and Assassin cost three. Secondary Assassin requires evil alignment. Multiple retained training choices contribute only the explicitly active profile.
Climbing (including its separate Rappelling check) and Swimming each cost one Physical Secondary choice. Other Physical skills remain unfinished.
Athletics costs one Physical Secondary selection and grants no percentile proficiency. Other Physical skills remain unfinished.
S.C.U.B.A. costs one Physical Secondary choice and requires Swimming. Other Physical skills remain unfinished.

Boxing is excluded from Secondary skills (printed 47 / PDF 48). Honor-system Secondary selections remain available with the eligibility warning. Physical/Athletic offers a normal program choice route.

conditional_guidance.hand-to-hand-assassin: Secondary Hand to Hand: Assassin requires evil alignment (printed47/PDF48); player adjudication applies on the honor system.

source.section: Ordinary Human attacks, action costs and four Hand to Hand training profiles

guidance: All heroes have two baseline attacks. At level 1, untrained characters gain one additional action; the active training profile replaces that contribution.
All reviewed training gives automatic parry; untrained parry and any dodge consume one action.
Power strikes double base dice and add ordinary P.S. damage once; each consumes two actions.
Low attributes, enhanced strength types, other training, Physical skills, proficiencies, powers, equipment and Heroes advancement remain unfinished.
